clue.text: Small computer over a fast one

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the word is turned upwards, read from bottom to top

parts.note: a Mac is an Apple computer

explanation.surface: A tiny laptop being slipped past someone in a con.
explanation.walkthrough: To pull a fast one is to trick someone, so a fast one is a con.
explanation.definitionFit: Pulling a fast one is an idiom for working a swindle on someone.

clue.text: Shell company with lawyer getting case dismissed

indicators.note: the case of a word is its outer letters, so dismissing it strips the first and last

parts.note: a brief is British slang for a barrister or defence lawyer

explanation.surface: A shell company whose lawyer gets the case against it thrown out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shell company' reads as one business term, but Shell alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowrie is a glossy sea snail whose shell was once used as money.

clue.text: What replenishes Losec on dwindling reserves

indicators.note: the phrase reserves, or holds within it, the letters wanted

parts.note: the answer runs unbroken through these words, from the end of Losec into dwindling

explanation.surface: Someone running low on Losec, a heartburn drug, wonders what will top up their supply.
explanation.walkthrough: Losec is a brand of the stomach-acid drug omeprazole; its name just supplies letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A second wind is a fresh surge of energy that restores a flagging runner's stamina.

clue.text: Dad exercised and took ten

parts.note: Pa is a familiar word for father
to exercise a right is to use it

explanation.surface: Father did his workout and then had a short rest.
explanation.walkthrough: To take ten is American slang for taking a ten-minute break.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking ten means stopping briefly for a breather, the same as halting for a moment.

clue.text: Tricky to capture English island, cut off in camera

indicators.note: one part captures, or holds inside it, the others

parts.note: sly means cunning or tricky

indicators.note: the island's last letter is cut off

parts.note: Crete is the large Greek island

explanation.surface: A devious plan to seize an English island that has been isolated, all done behind closed doors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In camera' looks like photography, but it is the legal Latin for in private.
explanation.definitionFit: A hearing held in camera takes place privately, away from the public.

clue.text: Skewer Spanish film adaptation of King novel

parts.note: Sp is the standard abbreviation for Spanish
It is Stephen King's horror novel, filmed in 1990 and 2017

explanation.surface: A kebab skewer turns up in a Spanish film version of a Stephen King book.
explanation.definitionFit: A spit is a rod pushed through meat for roasting, a large skewer.

clue.text: Sloppy drumming shook home's interior where the bros play

indicators.note: sloppy work is messy, so these letters are jumbled
the inside letters, without the first and last

parts.note: the word home; its possessive just links it to interior

explanation.surface: Messy drumming rattles a house in a games room where some brothers jam.
explanation.walkthrough: The bros are the Mario brothers of Nintendo's games, who live in this land; it is the puzzle's theme.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mushroom Kingdom is the fictional realm in which the Super Mario Bros video games are set.

clue.text: Almost excessively notice bro's friend

indicators.note: the word is almost complete, losing its last letter

parts.note: too means excessively
an ad is a notice advertising something

explanation.surface: A notice that is very nearly over the top, mentioning a brother's mate.
explanation.walkthrough: Toad is the mushroom-headed helper of Mario in the Nintendo games.
explanation.definitionFit: Toad is a loyal ally of the Mario brothers in the Nintendo game series.

clue.text: Person looking down barrel had to play along

parts.note: a cooper makes barrels, so inspects them closely; the phrase suggests a gunman
to have a meal is to eat it, so had gives ate

explanation.surface: Someone with a gun pointed at them had no choice but to go along with it.
explanation.walkthrough: Looking down a barrel suggests facing a gun; here it is a barrel-maker at work.
explanation.definitionFit: To cooperate is to work together, going along with others' plans.

clue.text: Far-out rock instrument unboxed in post office

indicators.note: the shortened instrument sits in, or inside, the post office letters
taken out of its box: the outer letters go

parts.note: the flute is a wind instrument

explanation.surface: A rock guitar taken out of its packaging at the post office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rock instrument' reads as an electric guitar, but rock belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Pluto is a small icy dwarf planet orbiting at the remote fringe of the solar system.

clue.text: Bro and mum meeting with port

parts.note: ma is a word for mother
Rio de Janeiro is a major Brazilian port

explanation.surface: A brother and his mother meet up with a glass of port.
explanation.definitionFit: Mario is the elder of the two plumber brothers in Nintendo's Super Mario Bros.

clue.text: Took out and scored

definitions.meaning: first meaning: withdrew a competitor or entry from an event
second meaning: marked with a line or scratch

explanation.walkthrough: Both readings sound like sport, a player withdrawn and a goal scored, but scored here means marked.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse scratched from a race is withdrawn, and a scratched surface has been marked with lines.

clue.text: Worked as required, when called for

indicators.note: called means spoken out, so the word is said rather than spelt

parts.note: needed means required

explanation.surface: Someone did their job just as needed, whenever they were summoned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Called for' sounds like a synonym of required, but called is the sound signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Dough is worked by kneading it, pressing and folding it with the hands.

clue.text: Ark vacated after big ruminant capsizes boat

indicators.note: the ark's letters come after the animal's
a capsized boat is upside down, so in a down clue the word reads upwards

parts.note: the yak is a large cud-chewing ox of Tibet

indicators.note: emptied of its inside, leaving the first and last letters

parts.note: the word ark, whose middle letter is then emptied out

explanation.surface: An abandoned Noah's ark with a huge yak that tips its boat over.
explanation.definitionFit: A kayak is a narrow canoe-like craft paddled with a double-bladed oar.

clue.text: Little stick, the sort in pool?

parts.note: a tad is a small amount
a pole is a long stick

explanation.surface: A short stick, the kind of thing found in a pond, with a hint of Mog's riddle.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the definition: the creature found in a pond is a frog in the making.
explanation.definitionFit: A tadpole is the larval form of a frog or toad, living in ponds before it grows legs.

clue.text: Doctor ends plasma collections before trial

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A medic finishes taking blood plasma before a clinical trial.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like the medic in the scene, but it is a verb meaning to alter.
explanation.definitionFit: Genetic swabs are gathered from suspects as evidence ahead of a criminal case.

clue.text: Lover of old paintings picked up more

parts.note: an ex is a former partner

indicators.note: lifted, so in a down clue the word is read upwards

parts.note: paintings collectively are art

explanation.surface: A collector of antique pictures buys some more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lover of old paintings' reads as an art connoisseur; split it after old.
explanation.definitionFit: Extra means additional, over and above the usual amount.

clue.text: Macho shouts greeting bro's ride

parts.note: yo is a laddish shout of greeting, so macho shouts are yos
hi is a greeting

explanation.surface: A tough guy hollers hello to his brother's lift.
explanation.walkthrough: Yoshi is the green dinosaur that Mario rides in the Nintendo games.
explanation.definitionFit: Yoshi is the dinosaur steed that carries Mario through many of his adventures.

clue.text: Wrong top for footballing worn by Iowa players

parts.note: a sin is a wrong

indicators.note: the top of a down word is its first letter

parts.note: the word whose first letter is taken
clothes being worn are on
IA is the postal code for Iowa

explanation.surface: Iowa players put on the wrong shirt for their football match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Top' looks like a football shirt; it means the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A sinfonia is a small orchestra, a group of musicians, as well as an early overture.

clue.text: Starchy veg put back in can

indicators.note: returned, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: the yam is a starchy tuber

explanation.surface: Starchy vegetables are returned to the tin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Can' looks like a tin, but it is the verb meaning to be permitted.
explanation.definitionFit: May and can both express permission, as in asking whether one is allowed.

clue.text: Not terribly into trending content reminders

indicators.note: one part goes into the other

parts.note: memes are jokes and images that spread rapidly online

indicators.note: done terribly, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Someone who is not hugely interested in viral online posts.
explanation.definitionFit: Mementos are keepsakes kept to recall a person or event.

clue.text: Heading off scoundrel US campus let in

indicators.note: the head, or first letter, is taken off

parts.note: a cad is a dishonourable man
MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology

explanation.surface: A rogue is headed off before an American university admits him.
explanation.definitionFit: To admit someone is to allow them entry.

clue.text: See 7
Cups passed around chill dance in Punjab

indicators.note: one part is placed around the other

parts.note: a bra has cups
to hang out is to chill

explanation.surface: Drinks circulate while people relax before a dance in the Punjab.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cups passed around' suggests drinks; cups is a bra.
explanation.definitionFit: Bhangra is a lively folk dance and music style from the Punjab region.

clue.text: Villain we roughed up with bros

indicators.note: knocked about, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A baddie admits that he and his gang beat up some lads.
explanation.walkthrough: Bowser is the spiky turtle king who kidnaps the princess in the Mario games.
explanation.definitionFit: Bowser is the chief antagonist of the Super Mario series, forever battling the brothers.

clue.text: Organs state installed in gutted Gewandhaus

indicators.note: one part is fitted inside the other
its insides are removed, leaving the first and last letters

parts.note: the Gewandhaus is Leipzig's concert hall
a land is a state, as in the German Länder

explanation.surface: Pipe organs fitted in a stripped-out Leipzig concert hall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Organs' looks like the instruments of the concert hall, but they are body organs.
explanation.definitionFit: Glands are bodily organs that secrete hormones or other substances.

clue.text: Fixed game was done poorly

parts.note: Go is the Chinese board game

indicators.note: done badly, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A rigged match that was badly carried out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fixed game' reads as match-fixing, but fixed means repaired.
explanation.definitionFit: Something mended so well it seems unused is as good as new.

clue.text: Golf after fundraising event

parts.note: à la means after the manner of, as in à la mode

explanation.surface: A golf day held after a charity function.
explanation.walkthrough: G is golf in the radio alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: A gala is a festive social occasion often held to raise money for charity.

clue.text: Still lacking place in compound for trip

indicators.note: the word is missing a part

parts.note: placid means calm or still
Pl is the address abbreviation for Place

explanation.surface: A chemical substance with no fixed spot is still being sought for a journey.
explanation.walkthrough: Trip is a drug experience; acid is LSD.
explanation.definitionFit: Acid is slang for LSD, the hallucinogenic chemical that brings on a trip.

clue.text: By the end of camp, every bro loves her

indicators.note: the last letter of the word

parts.note: the word whose final letter is taken
each means every

explanation.surface: When summer camp finishes, each brother has a crush on her.
explanation.walkthrough: Princess Peach is the royal whom Mario rescues, and loves, in the Nintendo games.
explanation.definitionFit: Princess Peach is Mario's sweetheart, the ruler he repeatedly saves from Bowser.

clue.text: Conceal literary alter ego in broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means spoken on air, so the word is heard, not seen

parts.note: Mr Hyde is Dr Jekyll's evil other self in Stevenson's novel

explanation.surface: Hiding a novelist's secret persona inside a radio programme.
explanation.definitionFit: To hide something is to keep it out of sight.

clue.text: Bro starts to look uncomfortable in karate outfit

indicators.note: the first letters of each of the next words

parts.note: the three words whose first letters are taken
a gi is the white suit worn for karate and judo

explanation.surface: A brother looks ill at ease in his martial arts kit.
explanation.walkthrough: Luigi is Mario's taller younger brother.
explanation.definitionFit: Luigi is the green-clad younger of the two Mario brothers.

clue.text: Old draft repaired, leaving intro unfixed

parts.note: to pen something is to write a draft of it

indicators.note: the intro, or first letter, is left out

parts.note: mended means repaired

explanation.surface: An old manuscript patched up, except for its opening, which is left unsettled.
explanation.definitionFit: An open-ended arrangement has no set limit or conclusion.
